snippet.title: Luctus Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Luctus on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2567380/Luctus/

"Luctus," brought to life through pixel art, delves into Nora's intricate and dramatic story. As you experience this mysterious tale, you will find yourself exploring an original world, getting to know diverse characters, and engaging in epic action moments by conjuring various flame spells!
